registered_before: any US v2 model fit, validation score or confirmation label read
purpose: Separate, pre-registered US county-yield experiments (IA/NE/KS) plus future-season scenario models; research only, no automatic promotion
v1_interpretation: The hist_age mismatch (fit ages ~2, validation/test ages 2-5) is a hypothesis to be tested by ablation, not a demonstrated cause of the v1 outcome.

data.labels: USDA NASS Quick Stats bulk qs.crops_20261114 (same compressed sha256 as v1); SURVEY county YIELD BU/ACRE, ALL PRODUCTION PRACTICES, converted to kg/ha exactly as v1

sealed.C1: crop year 2025 -> data/raw/us_training_v2/sealed_confirmation_2025.jsonl.gz, readable only by data/ingest/us_v2_confirm.py
sealed.future: crop years >= 2026 -> sealed_future.jsonl.gz (0 rows in snapshot)

data.weather: NASA POWER daily point (county internal point), 2000-01-01..2026-11-13; five variables PRECTOTCORR, T2M_MIN, T2M_MAX, RH2M, WS2M
data.radiation_excluded: ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN measured latency 75 days on 2026-11-14 retrieval; unavailable to an issue at the cutoff day
data.availability_rule: a label/source value enters a row issued at issued_at only if available_at <= issued_at; unknown = unavailable; estimated dates are conservative bounds and make the evaluation 'retrospective_estimated_availability'

counties.eligibility: development labels only: >=12 valid yields 2001-2024 per crop (both crops in IA/NE) and >=3 valid in the last 5 published crop years <=2024 (KS: 2019-2023 because 2024 winter wheat county estimates were not published)
counties.spatial_holdout: round(0.2 x eligible) per state by sha256('us_training_v2:spatial:FIPS'), anchors excluded; excluded from every fit, preprocessing and selection
counties.v1_population: v1 counties that are also v2-eligible

issue_kinds.in_season: issued_at = cutoff + 1 day; observed weather for the whole pre-cutoff window
issue_kinds.pre_6m: issued_at = window start - 6 months; no observed season weather
issue_kinds.pre_18m: issued_at = window start - 18 months; no observed season weather
issue_kinds.calendar: fixed regional windows as v1: soy 05-20 +90 d, maize 05-06 +90 d, winter wheat 10-02 of previous year +180 d
issue_kinds.history: history_at_issue: crop years published by issued_at and < target year; window of 10 crop years anchored on the latest published year; suppressed excluded but counted; last label resolved per county and crop
issue_kinds.grouping: all issue kinds, horizons and ensemble members of the same fips x crop x harvest year share one group for validation splits and bootstrap

development_selection.fold_rule: for validation year V and issue kind k: fit rows = target years < V whose label available_at <= issued_at(V, k); features of each fit row computed at its own issue; imputation/scaling/feature handling fitted inside the fold
development_selection.metric: county-balanced MAE (kg/ha) averaged over validation years, non-holdout counties
development_selection.horizon_policy: A = one weather+history model per issue kind; B = one shared model with hist_age, hist_count, hist_suppressed_in_window, lead_days and missing indicators. Chosen per scope by mean validation MAE over the three issue kinds (observed-weather rows), tie -> B
development_selection.pre_season_history_only: for pre_6m/pre_18m a history-only comparator is selected among baselines and history_ridge by validation MAE at that issue kind
development_selection.spatial_development_check: the same validation protocol scored on holdout counties (never fitted) for every confirmation comparison

E1a_availability.question: replaying availability vs a consistent fixed 2-year lag, same population and keys

E1b_expansion.question: training on all eligible counties vs v1 population only, both availability_replay, evaluated on the same keys

E1_mismatch_diagnostic.question: v1-style rule (fit at target-2, evaluate with a fixed ceiling at the end of the fit years) vs fixed_lag2, v1 population
E1_mismatch_diagnostic.status: development diagnostic only, not in the confirmation family

E2a_source.question: gridMET point vs POWER point, same features/population
E2a_source.status: conditional on gridMET retrieval within budget

E2b_weighting.question: gridMET weighted by previous-year CDL crop pixels (proxy) vs gridMET point
E2b_weighting.mask_rule: CDL year <= target-1 with available_at <= issued_at; else fallback point with flag

E3_ne_irrigation.question: NE: lagged irrigated share of harvested area (NASS survey practice split, last crop year 2018) and dry-exposure interactions vs base
E3_ne_irrigation.denominator: harvested area, GRAIN for maize; planted area not mixed

E4_ks_calendar.question: KS: window start at the state-level Crop Progress 50% planted date of the previous fall (reports published by issued_at) vs fixed 10-02, same cutoff day
E4_ks_calendar.extra_descriptor: growing degree days base 0 C (McMaster & Wilhelm 1997, Agric. For. Meteorol. 87:291-300)
E4_ks_calendar.pre_season: progress does not exist yet: fixed calendar

PRE_chain.question: pre_6m and pre_18m: P50 of the weather-model applied to every ensemble member (data/forecasting/weather_ensemble.py, analog years complete before issued_at) vs the history-only comparator at the same issue

exposure.IA: two Iowa 2025 county values were seen in search snippets before v1; IA results carry exposure_qualified and are reported separately

family.F1: in_season selected model vs last, mean3, trend, history_ridge (5 scopes x 4 = 20)
family.F4: E2a gridMET point vs POWER point (5)
family.justification: every confirmatory comparison registered here; horizon policy A/B, mismatch diagnostic and interval coverage are development or descriptive and not counted. Experiments not executed keep their slots (status not_executed), which only makes the correction more conservative.

confirmation.rule: confirmed only if: MAE gain >= 5% on C1 seen keys; paired county-cluster bootstrap (2000 reps, seed 42) Bonferroni upper bound for 53 comparisons < 0; non-negative MAE gain on holdout counties in development validation (>=30 pairs); >=30 C1 seen pairs. C1 spatial-holdout pairs are expected below 30 for every scope (10-17) and are reported descriptively.
confirmation.after_opening: no refit, reselection or threshold change is presented as independent evaluation; post-confirmation refits including 2025 are product models that inherit the C1 status of the frozen version

fields: information_used (sources, last label per county, observed weather through)
prospective_registry.2026: issued after harvest and before label release -> post-harvest pre-release estimate; not evidence of pre-harvest skill
prospective_registry.2027: KS winter wheat in season (sown fall 2026); IA/NE pre-season; eligible as genuinely prospective at the registered issue kind

scenarios.weather: data/forecasting/weather_ensemble.py (consecutive-day blocks of analog years, multivariate, leap-safe), analog years complete before issued_at; climatological scenario, not a forecast
scenarios.per_member: features and yield per member; FAO-56 water balance per member with US parameter sets where available
scenarios.uncertainty_included: weather-scenario spread; development residual quantiles of the same issue kind added in a separately labelled predictive band
scenarios.uncertainty_excluded: label revision, management change, technology trend break, structural model error beyond development residuals, climate trend
scenarios.seasonal_forecasts: not used in v2 (no hindcast evaluation available)

promotion: No US model is promoted automatically; maximum status research_confirmed; Brazilian models, registry and serving catalog untouched
